songs.title: EL DIOS QUE ADORAMOS
songs.content:
{bpm: 110}
{key: F#}
{artist: Sovering Grace}
{title: EL DIOS QUE ADORAMOS}

EL DIOS QUE ADORAMOS

[INTRO]
[F#] [C#] [D#m] [B] [F#] [C#]
V[F#]ERS[C#]O 1 El Dios que hizo los cielos y la tierra
[D#m]Con [B]el poder de Su palabra, Reina con autoridad
E[F#]l D[C#]ios que aún los vientos le obedecen
U[D#m]na p[B]alabra es suficiente para los muertos levantar

[PRE-CORO]
[B]Na[C#]die es como El, oh gran Yo Soy
[F#]CORO Tú eres el Dios que adoramos
[C#]Todopoderoso y soberano
G[D#m]rand[B]e [F#]en [C#]misericordia y poder para salvar
[F#]Tú eres el Dios que adoramos
Q[C#]uien derrotó la muerte y el pecado
[D#m]Glor[B]io[D#m]so R[C#]edentor y Rey, Te adoramos
[F#]VER[C#]SO 2 El Dios que descendió desde Su trono
[D#m]Para [B]llevar sobre Sus hombros nuestra culpa y transgresión
J[F#]esú[C#]s, exaltado sobre todo
[D#m]Nomb[B]re sobre todo nombre solo en Él hay salvación

[PUENTE]
[B]A [C#]Él sea la gloria y el poder
[B/D#]Todo [C#]es de Él y para Él

songs.title: Brown Eyed Girl
Don't Look Back in Anger
Don't Stop Believin'
songs.techNotes: Build lighting through the song — starts low, full blast at "Don't stop". Confetti on last chorus if available.

songs.title: Eye of the Tiger
songs.techNotes: Punchy white strobes on the riff hits. Kick drum trigger for light flash if available.

songs.title: Have You Ever Seen the Rain
Hey Ya!
songs.techNotes: Party lights — fast color rotation. House lights up on "shake it like a Polaroid picture".

songs.title: Hotel California
songs.techNotes: Dim lights for intro, slow build. Spotlight on lead guitar for the outro solo. No strobes.

songs.title: I'm Yours
Jolene
songs.techNotes: Single warm spot on vocalist. No fills, no color changes. Intimate.

songs.title: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
songs.techNotes: Slow fade up from blackout. Warm amber only. House lights for the final singalong round.

songs.title: La Bamba
Let It Be
Livin' on a Prayer
songs.techNotes: Talk box needs DI channel 3. Strobes on the key change. House lights up on final chorus for singalong.

songs.title: Mr. Brightside
songs.techNotes: Full house lights on chorus — everyone knows this one. Fast color chase during verses.

songs.title: No Woman No Cry
songs.notes: Play the live version feel. Bass walkdown on G/B is essential.

songs.title: Proud Mary
songs.techNotes: Starts slow — blue wash. When tempo doubles, full stage blast and strobes. Sound: watch gain on the tempo change.

songs.title: Redemption Song
songs.notes: Acoustic guitar only. Fingerpicked intro, strummed verses. Keep it sparse and raw.

songs.title: Riptide
Should I Stay or Should I Go
Smoke on the Water
songs.techNotes: Red wash on stage during riff. Fog machine on the organ solo. Cut fog before last chorus.

songs.title: Stand By Me
Sultans of Swing
songs.techNotes: Spotlight follows lead guitar. Tight solo spot for the outro. Keep stage dark during fingerpicking intro.

songs.title: Summer of '69
Sweet Child O' Mine
songs.techNotes: Spotlight on guitar for intro riff. Full stage lights on verse entry. Big reverb on vocals for chorus.

songs.title: Sweet Home Alabama
Take Me Home, Country Roads
Three Little Birds
songs.notes: Only 3 chords. Reggae off-beat strum is everything — mute on 1 and 3, strum on the and of 2 and 4.

songs.title: Twist and Shout
Use Somebody
Wagon Wheel
Wish You Were Here
Wonderwall
songs.techNotes: House lights up — crowd will sing. Cut monitors, vocals through FOH only. Warm amber wash.

songs.title: Zombie
songs.techNotes: Green/cold wash for verses. Hard red on chorus. Heavy delay on vocal "zombie" hits.

setlists.name: Acoustic Sundown
setlists.notes: Intimate setting, all acoustic. No PA — play quietly.

setlists.name: Brit Rock
setlists.notes: UK anthems. Expect the crowd to sing louder than you.

setlists.name: Classic Rock Night

sets.name: Set 1
sets.notes: High energy openers — keep the crowd moving

sets.name: Set 2
sets.notes: Build to the big sing-along closer

setlists.notes: Loud and proud. Full band, no acoustic breaks.

setlists.name: Crowd Pleasers

sets.name: Set 2
sets.notes: Wonderwall last — let the crowd take over

setlists.notes: Festival slot, 45 min. Every song a hit, no downtime.

setlists.name: Latin & Feel-Good Vibes
setlists.notes: Sunset set. Keep it warm and groovy.
